messages.subject: surrogate probabilistic models
parts:
Hi,

Anybody had experience with surrogate probabilistic modeling? For example we have a complicated system like a supply chain under uncertainity (uncertain demand/production times/transportation times/etc). We perform series of simulated experiments by varying discrete and continuous factors and then try building a surrogate probabilistic model to reduce the dimensionality of design space since original design space (number of factors) is too large.

My question is:
- Are there any effective methods to reduce the number of discrete factors (some sort of PCA - principal component analysis but hopefully in the original space of design variables)
- Estimating parameter distribution of reduced order probabilistic model (using stan)

The key is discrete variables since for continuous variables there is body of literature available.

Thanks for any references.
Linas
